cards.card_text: After the whole LIST, Eliphaz turns around and hands Job an invitation: “Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.” That's like your boss chewing you out for an hour and then sliding you a cookie.
cards.verse_text: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
cards.snippet: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to…

cards.card_text: Leave the gift and go reconcile first Offer the gift and pray for him after Bring a bigger gift to make up for it
cards.verse_text: First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.

cards.card_text: Reconcile quickly, Jesus says, or your adversary may hand you to the judge, the judge to the officer, and into prison you may go.
cards.verse_text: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court.

cards.verse_text: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.
cards.snippet: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.

cards.card_text: When we were enemies of God, Paul says we were reconciled to Him through what?
cards.verse_text: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!

cards.card_text: Stay unmarried or be reconciled to him Remarry or go back to her family Wait a year or ask the elders
cards.verse_text: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband.
cards.snippet: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband.

cards.card_text: All this is from God, Paul says, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ.
cards.verse_text: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
cards.snippet: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

cards.verse_text: We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
cards.snippet: We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.

cards.card_text: And God was pleased, through the Son, to reconcile all things to Himself, things on earth and things in heaven.
cards.verse_text: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him, and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
cards.snippet: …to have all His fullness dwell in Him, and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven,…

cards.card_text: But now they've been reconciled by Christ's physical body through death.
cards.verse_text: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
